grace: Heads-up: enterprise POC — fn_call outputs intermittently return required numeric fields as null when using json_mode=strict + streaming. Demo in <24h, need a quick mitigation plan.

omar: can you paste a redacted example and the model/request id? also confirm streaming and headers.

grace: example (redacted): ```{"tool":"invoice_parser","name":"parse","arguments":{"invoice_id":"INV-100","total":null}}``` request: r-zz99aa; model: r-infer-1-large; streaming=true; Content-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8. Occurs ~12% runs.

lucy: quick hypotheses: 1) mid-stream truncation when streaming cuts output -> strict parser coerces missing numeric tokens to null; 2) model emits placeholders ("N/A","—") that coercer can't parse; 3) client charset/BOM issues. Any raw_response examples with trailing garbage?

grace: customer attached a raw string that sometimes has extra text after the closing brace: `}\nNote: total estimated...`

omar: two parallel mitigations: A) client side for demo: run non-streaming and/or add an explicit sentinel like "<END_JSON>" and require a ```json``` fence; B) server side hotpatch: feature-flag tolerant extractor that does bracket-balanced extraction, strips trailing garbage, and normalizes common placeholders to numbers where appropriate. Estimate ~1 dev-day for gated hotpatch.

lucy: also ask customer to provide raw_response base64 and proxy logs. ops-bot: any TLS issues during same timeframe?

ops-bot: [connector] 1799990045 WARN tls upstream err="verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate"

omar: that TLS message usually means their inspection appliance is terminating TLS. For demo options: 1) passthrough their appliance for our endpoints, 2) import our CA into their appliance, or 3) allowlist our egress so inspection is skipped. Passthrough is fastest.

grace: sales ask: customer worried about token cost if we switch to non-streaming or add retries. How to position?

lucy: position as demo-stabilization — token delta is small at demo QPS. Offer to estimate from sample traces and propose a short demo credit if needed.

omar: short checklist for debugging: gather raw_response (base64 OK), exact system+user prompt, headers (Content-Type charset), and any proxy cert chain/logs showing TLS errors. Grace, can you request those and offer the tolerant flag for the demo?

grace: will request artifacts and offer the tolerant extractor flag plus the prompt-sentinel approach. I'll ask them to run a single non-streaming sample while we ship the hotpatch. Ping me when the flag branch is ready.

lucy: i'll draft the customer-facing note with the three mitigation options and token guidance. omar: please estimate dev ETA for the hotpatch so we can promise a timeline.

omar: ETA ~24 hours for feature-flagged tolerant extractor + QA. Rollback via flag.

grace: thanks team — i'll update the ticket and coordinate with customer security on TLS passthrough.

ops-bot: action created HOTFIX-PT-101 assigned to omar, due 24h.
